title: Global extreme poverty rate
definition: The share of the world population living below the international extreme poverty line of $3.00 per person per day in 2021 purchasing power parity (PPP).

sources.publisher: World Bank Group, Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP)
sources.title: March 2026 Update to the Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP)

points.evidence: Global poverty table ($3.00 per day, 2021 PPP): world extreme poverty headcount ratio in 2021 is 11.3 percent.
